ageing_relevance.rationale: About 10% of B2M papers concern ageing, and about 5% concern senescence, which is a moderate share. Open Targets lists no ageing-related disease associations, and the project context only concerns a DNA-methylation surrogate within GrimAge, not measured B2M protein.

evidence.value: One of seven plasma proteins whose DNA-methylation surrogates make up GrimAge, the mortality clock that was +4.3 years older in schizophrenia in part 1 of this project (an effect explained by smoking). The surrogates are methylation estimates, not measured protein levels. Shirai et al. 2024 (7-cohort meta-analysis): DNAm-predicted level higher in schizophrenia/first-episode psychosis.

background_knowledge: Circulating B2M has been reported to rise with age and, in mouse studies, to impair cognition and neurogenesis. This is from my own knowledge, not the tools.

mechanism.rationale: B2M's core function is well understood: it is the MHC class I light chain and is secreted. Its causal role in human ageing and the direction of modulation are not established. Lowering circulating B2M might help, but blocking MHC I function would be harmful.

evidence.value: Component of the class I major histocompatibility complex (MHC). Involved in the presentation of peptide antigens to the immune system.

background_knowledge: Free circulating B2M is shed from MHC I and is cleared by the kidney. Its levels rise as renal function falls.

tractability.rationale: Open Targets lists small-molecule evidence (a structure with ligand and a high-quality pocket), antibody-relevant features from its secreted and cell-surface localisation, and PROTAC features. There is no clinical-stage or approved modulator.

safety.rationale: Open Targets records no safety liabilities, but absence of data is not evidence of safety. The top disease association, MHC class I deficiency, indicates that loss of B2M function impairs antigen presentation. Systemic inhibition therefore carries a plausible immune risk.
background_knowledge: B2M loss is a known tumour immune-evasion mechanism, and B2M-knockout mice have impaired CD8 T-cell development. This is from my own knowledge, not the tools.

clinical_precedence.rationale: The tools list no drugs acting on B2M.

assessment.summary: B2M is the secreted MHC class I light chain. About 10% of its literature concerns ageing, but Open Targets lists no ageing-disease associations. The project link is only through a DNA-methylation surrogate within GrimAge, and that surrogate is not measured protein. Tractability evidence exists for small molecules and antibodies, but no drug has reached the clinic. Safety data are empty, yet the MHC class I deficiency association points to an immune risk from systemic inhibition. The direction of modulation is unclear, so my recommendation is to deprioritise B2M as a therapeutic target, though it may still be useful as a biomarker.
